name: nutrition-formula-engine-web
description: Browser ingestion and review UI for traceable formulation analysis

scripts.build: pnpm generate:readability && vite build && cp public/robots.txt public/sitemap.xml public/llms.txt dist/ && cp -R public/footer-art public/fonts dist/ && python3 scripts/generate-agent-pages.py --copy-to-dist && node scripts/check-deploy-assets.js
scripts.check: pnpm test && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/recent-formulas.js && node --check public/case-studies.js && node --check vite.config.js && pnpm build
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && uv run pywrangler deploy --tag "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
